title: ATP Selectively Releases ClpH, but Not GroX, from a Heat-Damaged Casein Matrix
authors: Tara Moss, Ken Daro, and Eli Senn | Synthetic Chaperone Interaction Unit
research_question: Do ClpH and GroX differ in ATP-Mg2+-dependent release from a heat-damaged casein matrix?
key_findings: ATP-Mg2+ released 81% of ClpH but 7% of GroX
ATP without MgCl2 released 24% of ClpH
conclusion: ClpH and GroX both bind damaged casein, but only ClpH is efficiently released by ATP-Mg2+.
critical_negations: ATP alone was insufficient for efficient release
GroX was not released efficiently by ATP-Mg2+
forbidden_claims: ATP-Mg2+ prevented both proteins from binding
